name: 34846-prefill-30b-a3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. One in-process engine, the whole model on one card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1024 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, seed static 34846.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`: 4096 prompt tokens and 128 output tokens per request, min == max == mean on both.
purpose: A document summarization assistant with long inputs and brief summaries, serving 16 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. The engine is the source checkout named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
max-num-seqs: 16
max-model-len: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
